=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:186-191 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The stale `.claude/commands/` copy uses ambiguous “the procedure's step 2” references instead of the explicit project-branch sync references in its twin.
  WHY: A session can mistake the Claude-asset sync's step 2 for the project-branch sync step, failing to find the merge command and subject; reviewers rated this BLOCKER and MAJOR.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:various | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/` copies fail to sync byte-identically with the `workflow-templates/` twins, retaining stale, ambiguous, and incorrect sync logic.
  WHY: An unattended session may run stale procedures instead of the verified, base-aware logic, leaving the project branch unsynced and the environment inconsistent.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `.claude/commands/` copy omits the twin's clause requiring the failed-fetch error line in the blocker comment.
  WHY: A session handling a project-base check failure caused by a failed fetch would omit that diagnostic from the blocker comment.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The conflict notification hardcodes `<default>` instead of using `<source>`.
  WHY: During a project-branch or PR-base merge conflict, the operator receives a notification naming the wrong conflict source.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:189 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The blocker-evidence diff assumes `origin/<project branch>` was fetched successfully.
  WHY: A transient fetch failure produces a raw Git error in the blocker comment instead of the documented named check and differing paths.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:182 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The heading promises “Two checks” although the base-drift check is conditional.
  WHY: A literal reading leads to redundant fetch and diff operations for a default-bound PR head or project branch.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:implement-plan-claude.md (181, 183, 188), fix-claude-pr.md (46) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The same PR-base-ref concept uses inconsistent placeholder names, `<base>` and `<base ref>`.
  WHY: Copying prose between files can leave a placeholder that references a nonexistent remote ref, leading to check failures.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

Three lines in implement-plan-claude.md differ (ambiguous "the procedure's step 2" references where the twin uses explicit "**Sync the project branch** bullet of [Procedure](#procedure) step 2" references), and fix-claude-pr.md lacks the failed-fetch error-line clause.
